kpis.name: daily_revenue
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) as value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset op JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = DATE('now') AND o.order_status != 'canceled'

kpis.name: average_order_value
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(op.payment_value), 0) as value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset op JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = DATE('now') AND o.order_status != 'canceled'

kpis.name: daily_order_volume
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as value FROM olist_orders_dataset o WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = DATE('now') AND o.order_status != 'canceled'

kpis.name: customer_churn_rate
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE('now', '-60 days') AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) < DATE('now', '-30 days')), 0), 0) as value FROM olist_customers_dataset c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE('now', '-60 days') AND DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) < DATE('now', '-30 days')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE('now', '-30 days'))

kpis.name: conversion_rate
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as value FROM olist_orders_dataset o WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = DATE('now')

kpis.name: payment_approval_rate
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN ('approved', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered') THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as value FROM olist_orders_dataset o WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = DATE('now')

kpis.name: average_delivery_time
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 0) as value FROM olist_orders_dataset o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) >= DATE('now', '-7 days')

kpis.name: on_time_delivery_rate
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as value FROM olist_orders_dataset o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) >= DATE('now', '-7 days')

kpis.name: repeat_customer_rate
kpis.sql_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN customer_order_count > 1 THEN o.customer_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 0) as value FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as customer_order_count FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY customer_id) customer_stats JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON o.customer_id = customer_stats.customer_id WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE('now', '-30 days')
